title: Florida House, District 102
what_it_does: Represents District 102 (Part of Broward) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Mery Lopez-Palma
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Attorney (own law office since 2003); small-business owner including Vicky Bakery franchise locations
candidates.background: Mery Lopez-Palma, 56, was born in Cuba and came to Florida as a child. She has practiced law for more than two decades, owns bakery franchise locations and is a mother of four. She won the August 2026 Republican primary for the Davie-Plantation-Sunrise district.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

abortion.summary: Lopez-Palma describes herself as pro-life, supporting exceptions for the life of the mother and those in current Florida law.
abortion.quote: I am pro-life and believe every human life is precious.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Mery Lopez-Palma

elections.summary: She strongly disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo ID and supports ensuring only citizens vote, with fee waivers for required documents.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Mery Lopez-Palma

taxes.summary: She pledges to lower taxes where possible and cut unnecessary regulations to ease burdens on homeowners and small businesses.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Mery Lopez-Palma

insurance.summary: Her approach to insurance is to increase market competition and reduce fraud and unnecessary costs.
insurance.quote: We should address both by increasing competition in the insurance market, reducing fraud and unnecessary costs, and pursuing responsible tax relief.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Mery Lopez-Palma

healthcare.summary: She favors workforce development, price transparency and private-sector solutions, with careful review of Medicaid spending.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Mery Lopez-Palma

crime.summary: Her site pledges to support law enforcement and she says she will back investments in police, firefighters and first responders.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Mery Lopez-Palma

property_tax.summary: She says property taxes strain family budgets and supports responsible tax relief.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Mery Lopez-Palma

candidates.name: Michael Friend
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Dentist (25+ years); small-business owner; national dental director for an insurance carrier
candidates.background: Mike Friend, 50, is a Davie dentist who has practiced for more than 25 years and also serves as a national dental director for an insurance carrier. A University of Pennsylvania dental graduate, he is a public-school parent and serves on advisory boards for NSU's College of Dental Medicine and the Town of Davie. He won the August 2026 Democratic primary.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

healthcare.summary: Friend says health-care access is his central issue and wants to take on health insurers, invest in preventive care and community health centers and expand the provider workforce.
healthcare.quote: Florida needs a pragmatic fighter like me to take on the health insurance carriers.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Michael Friend

abortion.summary: He says reproductive decisions belong out of politicians' hands and supports abortion access, with prevention as a focus.
abortion.quote: I strongly believe that woman's reproductive rights belong out of the hands of politicians.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Michael Friend

insurance.summary: He supports a state catastrophic fund to protect homeowners, stronger consumer protections and fair-dealing requirements for insurers, alongside more competition and home hardening.
insurance.quote: focus on a state catastrophic fund that will protect homeowners and not insurance companies.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Michael Friend

housing.summary: He backs full use of state housing programs, public-private partnerships and streamlined permitting to expand affordable and workforce housing.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Michael Friend

growth.summary: He says the balance has shifted too far toward state preemption and local governments should keep the ability to respond to local needs.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Michael Friend

elections.summary: He would waive fees and expand assistance so a proof-of-citizenship rule does not block eligible voters.

sources.title: Vote411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters): Michael Friend
